candidate_length.definition: number of tags in primary_pos_sequence from the frozen overlap-aware candidate span

tf.normalization: within record and exact candidate_length: count_in_doc / sum(count_in_doc)

domain_focus.fit_source: frozen gold from the other two OOF folds only; deduplicated by record_id + gold_canonical_key
domain_focus.domain_gold_df_fit: number of fit records containing the gold canonical key

phrase_quality.structural_prior: fit-gold POS-category frequency normalized by the maximum POS-category frequency in the same fold-pure fit gold
phrase_quality.length_prior: fit-gold Kiwi token-length-bin frequency normalized by the maximum length-bin frequency in the same fold-pure fit gold
phrase_quality.hanja_sensitive_revision: fit-gold priors are rebuilt from K06 v1.02 revised primary gold; Hanja-inclusive primary identities are not collapsed to Hangul-only aliases
phrase_quality.generic_unicode_structural_quality: diagnostic only; not used in the Korean core PhraseQuality
